test_map_str: test CategoricalIndex.map with str function preserves categorical type and ordered flag for string and interval data
test_map: test CategoricalIndex.map with lambda, dict, and Series mappers preserves categories and returns correct index type
test_map_with_categorical_series: test CategoricalIndex.map with a categorical Series mapper returns CategoricalIndex while non-categorical Series returns regular Index
test_map_with_nan_ignore: test CategoricalIndex.map with na_action='ignore' leaves NaN values unmapped instead of applying the function
test_map_with_nan_none: test CategoricalIndex.map with na_action=None applies the function to NaN values like pd.isna returning True
